```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Global chunk options: every figure is written to figures/ in PNG and PDF.
# File names follow the pattern <fig.path><chunk-label>-<n>.<ext>
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  fig.path   = "figures/",
  dev        = c("png", "pdf"),
  dpi        = 300,
  fig.width  = 7,
  fig.height = 5,
  fig.align  = "center"
)
```

## Load packages and data
 I can write all the text I want 
 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

data(iris)
str(iris)
head(iris)
```

## Summary statistics

```{r summary-stats}
# Split the data by species
setosa     <- iris[iris$Species == "setosa", ]
versicolor <- iris[iris$Species == "versicolor", ]
virginica  <- iris[iris$Species == "virginica", ]

# Build the summary table, one column per statistic
stats <- data.frame(
  Species      = c("setosa", "versicolor", "virginica"),
  n            = c(nrow(setosa), nrow(versicolor), nrow(virginica)),
  mean_sepal_L = c(mean(setosa$Sepal.Length), mean(versicolor$Sepal.Length), mean(virginica$Sepal.Length)),
  sd_sepal_L   = c(sd(setosa$Sepal.Length),   sd(versicolor$Sepal.Length),   sd(virginica$Sepal.Length)),
  mean_petal_L = c(mean(setosa$Petal.Length), mean(versicolor$Petal.Length), mean(virginica$Petal.Length)),
  sd_petal_L   = c(sd(setosa$Petal.Length),   sd(versicolor$Petal.Length),   sd(virginica$Petal.Length))
)

# Display the table
knitr::kable(stats, digits = 2)
```

## Figures

### Sepal length vs petal length

#### Base R

```{r scatter-base, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.5}
# Same axis limits for the three panels (like facet_wrap does)
x_limits <- range(iris$Sepal.Length)
y_limits <- range(iris$Petal.Length)

# Split the plotting window into 1 row and 3 columns
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

plot(setosa$Sepal.Length, setosa$Petal.Length,
     xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits,
     xlab = "Sepal length (cm)", ylab = "Petal length (cm)",
     main = "setosa", pch = 16)

plot(versicolor$Sepal.Length, versicolor$Petal.Length,
     xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits,
     xlab = "Sepal length (cm)", ylab = "Petal length (cm)",
     main = "versicolor", pch = 16)

plot(virginica$Sepal.Length, virginica$Petal.Length,
     xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits,
     xlab = "Sepal length (cm)", ylab = "Petal length (cm)",
     main = "virginica", pch = 16)

# Reset the plotting window to a single panel
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

#### ggplot2

```{r scatter-ggplot, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.5}
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Sepal length (cm)", y = "Petal length (cm)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Petal width distribution by species

#### Base R

```{r boxplot-base}
# Boxplot: one box per species, outliers hidden (the points are added below)
boxplot(Petal.Width ~ Species, data = iris,
        col = c("salmon", "lightgreen", "lightblue"),
        ylab = "Petal width (cm)",
        outline = FALSE)

# Add the individual points with some horizontal jitter
stripchart(Petal.Width ~ Species, data = iris,
           vertical = TRUE, method = "jitter", jitter = 0.15,
           pch = 16, cex = 0.6, add = TRUE)
```

#### ggplot2

```{r boxplot-ggplot}
ggplot(iris, aes(Species, Petal.Width, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(y = "Petal width (cm)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
